premises.text: Social media content consumption is extremely noisy so gems people care about get lost
premises.evidence_span: The problem is it's just way too noisy. Over 400 million tweets and over 4 billion Facebook posts every single day

premises.text: Undrip is a community focused only on sharing and discovering interesting web content—no status updates, check-ins, or game invites
premises.evidence_span: no status updates, no check-ins, no game invites. It's all about sharing and discovering the most interesting and compelling content from around the web, noise-free

premises.text: Connects Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, Tumblr and analyzes feeds to surface the best content
premises.evidence_span: With UNDRIP, I can connect my Twitter, my Facebook, my Instagram, my Tumblr, and it'll analyze all the content that's coming through, and it'll surface the best stuff

premises.text: Social context under each item shows friends who shared it; interactions flow back to originating networks
premises.evidence_span: under every single piece of content, you'll see thumbnails. Those are my friends. Those are people who I know. I value their opinion

premises.text: Algorithm uses consumption habits, friend relationships, and popularity signals for relevance while allowing serendipity; interests are implicit
premises.evidence_span: The UNDRIP algorithm will analyze my consumption habits. It'll analyze the relationships I have with my friends. It'll analyze the global, the local popularity

premises.text: Users can follow tastemaker curators whose shares mix into the ranking feed, and reshare via Drip
premises.evidence_span: a user can start to explore and learn about some of the other users on UnDrip and decide if they want to follow their content

premises.text: Product is mobile-first on iPhone and iPad with Android coming
premises.evidence_span: probably most importantly, it's all mobile. We're on the iPhone. We're on the iPad. We're in the App Store

value.text: Discover and share the gems of the web in a noise-free mobile community
value.evidence_span: Undrip is a mobile community that helps you discover and share the gems of the web

secondary_value.text: Create relevance and order for the social web like Google did for the web
secondary_value.evidence_span: What Google did for the web, which is create relevance and order to all the content out there, we're doing for the social web

notes: Soft count 7; founder bio excluded. Path-for-links analogy not separate premise.
